## Policy change

**Policies affected:** POL-

**Type of change:**
- [ ] New policy
- [ ] Material change (requirements added, removed or tightened): bump the major version and get re-approval
- [ ] Minor change (clarification, formatting): bump the minor version
- [ ] Annual review with no changes: update `approved_on` only

**Summary of what changed and why:**

**Approval:** The approver named in the front matter must approve this pull request. The merge commit is the approval record.

- [ ] `policykit lint --strict` passes
- [ ] Statement ids are unchanged or retired, never renumbered
